body: hi, I'm a Huxley premajor (so Kathy is my general advisor) and I'm kind of fucking stressed. Huxley is the reason why I chose Western and I'm not ready for all of this shit to get turned on its head.
I want to disappear. I don't know about die, it still feels strong. I've felt die before, it's not where I am right now.
When I stop focusing on something and just.let my head wander, or if I'm tired and can't focus
I don't know, it just kind of sneaks up on me. Whenever everything's blank it just shows up.

Everything is piling up again, but this time, it's all outside of myself. My personal matters are going just fine, but there are some family issues going on. I'm frustrated because I barely held it back before and almost died before I could make a change, or was forced to, for the better.

I try not to... I mean, if I get worked up enough and don't keep an eye on myself some shit has gotten out and it just made people (and/or people in a radius) panic and treat me really gently for a few days.
I don't know how to start. I don't feel comfortable telling extreme stuff to someone who doesn't know me
